name: John Petriello

events.title: Alive with wife in Aug 1934
events.description: Son Charles's marriage-license application lists father John and mother Mary (maiden name 'Bibisi'), both born in Italy and residing in Scranton; father's occupation 'Mdse'.

events.title: Family house after his death
events.description: A year after his death, three of his sons (James, Nicholas, Charles) were renting separate units at 1028 Bunker Hill St, his former home and store address.

bioAdditions: The Pennsylvania state death index for 1939 lists 'Giovanni J Petrillo' of Scranton, Lackawanna County, who died on 25 April 1939, under state file number 37883 (S1). This independently confirms the 1939 death year (against the Ancestry index's 1937) and gives the number needed to order his death certificate, which should name his parents and birthplace. Five years earlier, in August 1934, son Charles's marriage-license application had shown John and Mary both still living in Scranton, with John still in 'merchandise', i.e. running his grocery (S2). After his death the family kept the Bunker Hill house. In the April 1940 census his sons James, Nicholas and Charles were each renting a unit at no. 1028 (S3).
